test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 7 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statement and courses of action carefully and decide which of the courses of action logically follow(s) from the statement. 

**Statements: **

An epidemic disease has spread in an XYZ area due to contaminated water in a nearby pond. 

**Courses of Action: **

(i) Awareness of preventive measures regarding the spread of that disease must be communicated in that area and in the area nearby. 

(ii) The people of XYZ area must be shifted to other areas populated with healthy people. 

(iii) The contaminated water body must be treated.
solution:
Given:

**Statement**: An epidemic disease has spread in an XYZ area due to contaminated water in a nearby pond.

**Course of Action:**

I. Awareness of preventive measures regarding the spread of that disease must be communicated in that area and in the area nearby - **True **(Because, raising awareness can help prevent further spread of the disease and educate the community on how to protect themselves.)

II. The people of XYZ area must be shifted to other areas populated with healthy people - **False **(Because, relocating the population does not address the root cause of the epidemic and is impractical in the short term.)

III. The contaminated water body must be treated - **True **(Because, treating the contaminated water source will directly address the cause of the disease and help in controlling the outbreak.)

So, **Courses of Action I and III follow.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
